metadata.description: Combined benchmark results across multiple depths
metadata.timing_methodology: Solver instances are reused across scrambles within a batch. Thistlethwaite and Kociemba still lazy-load heavy tables inside their first timed solve call, so one-off initialization cost is amortized but not strictly excluded from solve_time_seconds.

depth_5.timing_methodology: Solver instances are reused across scrambles within a batch. Thistlethwaite and Kociemba still lazy-load heavy tables inside their first timed solve call, so one-off initialization cost is amortized but not strictly excluded from solve_time_seconds.
depth_5.scramble_depth_semantics: scramble_depth records the requested scramble length; verified_scramble_depth is populated only when the exact distance is known from the optimal Korf backend.

metadata.scramble_corpus_status: Legacy canonical thesis corpus generated before no-consecutive-same-face scramble generation was added. Scramble depth fields are requested lengths; some sequences contain adjacent same-face moves and cancellations.

environment.note: Post-hoc archive environment metadata added for reproducibility context; the original benchmark run did not record full hardware/package metadata.

external_exact_backend.note: Backend package metadata was inspected post hoc on the archive machine; the original benchmark run did not record a wheel hash or upstream commit hash.
